thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert for nebula-prod (VPC tenant) — nebula-pool-2 reporting sustained 5xx > 90% for 6m. Auto-escalation to #incidents. Thread opened 2816004321

jason-oncall-sre: I'm taking the page. jumping into logs now. tagging runtime + platform.

samir-runtime: looking at the aggregator — kernel OOMs on two gpus in nebula-pool-2, mem growth from model q4_1-2. sequence length spike from customer A's batch job.

priya-platform: autoscaler did a burst add 4 nodes ~09:12 UTC, but they immediately crashed during load. I'm pausing further autoscale.

jason-oncall-sre: immediate mitigation plan: 1) isolate nebula-prod traffic to avoid noisy neighbour, 2) route new requests to nebula-fallback-pool (smaller model or non-quantized variant), 3) enable rate-limit for NEBULA service key to 60% of previous. Priya can you create the isolation rule?

priya-platform: creating isolation ACL now — will pin nebula-prod to a quarantined subnet and remove other tenants from that pool. Running command:

```bash
# isolate pool
redwoodctl pools set-tenant --pool nebula-pool-2 --tenant nebula-prod --quarantine true
redwoodctl routing set --tenant nebula-prod --target nebula-fallback-pool --mode drain
```

priya-platform: ACL applied, routing update pushed, drain in progress. Estimated 30s to start failover.

mike-eng-runtime: fallback pool uses v2-small-q4 variant; latency will increase ~120-200ms p95 but stable. We should be explicit to customer.

jess-cust-succ: pinging Claire (nebula AM). letting them know we're failing over and what to expect. Drafting message.

ella-am: thanks, Jess — they'll want the impact window and SLA position. Can you track error counts and affected requests per minute?

samir-runtime: current error counts: 5xx spike started 09:08 UTC, peaked 09:13 UTC. Totals: ~42k failed requests over 12 minutes, ~120k total requests in window. Estimating 35% of requests were affected (rough metric).

jess-cust-succ: sending initial note to Claire: "We detected high error rates affecting requests served from your dedicated pool nebula-pool-2 at ~09:08 UTC. We are isolating the pool and failing traffic to a fallback pool; you may see an increase in latency while we stabilize. We'll follow up with a timeline and next steps."

olivia-product: please capture whether any prompt/results truncated or returned partial responses — that affects quality metric. Samir, can you check logs for partial token returns?

samir-runtime: scanning traces — ~12% returned truncated payloads (client got chunked errors) vs full 5xx. Storing traces to incident bucket nebula/2816004321/traces for RCA.

jason-oncall-sre: mitigation status: isolation done, traffic diverted successfully at 09:15 UTC. Error rate trending down to baseline ~09:18 UTC. We'll keep monitoring for 30m.

priya-platform: root cause preliminary: model variant memory regression (recent rollout of q4_1-2 to fallback? actually rollout to nebula-pool-2 02 days ago) + an unseen sequence-length distribution for NebulaCorp's batch jobs. We'll open a rollback job for that variant in nebula-pool-2.

mike-eng-runtime: queued rollback to q4_1-stable on nebula-pool-2; ETA for rollout 45m with canary. We'll not rejoin nebula-prod until we validate.

jess-cust-succ: Claire replied: "Thanks. Customers saw timeouts in their UI; they need an exec summary and compensation info." pushing to AM + legal.

ella-am: we need a crisp post-incident customer comms draft and a recommendation for credits. What are our SLOs for dedicated pools again?

samir-runtime: Dedicated API uptime SLO: 99.9% monthly availability per tenant by contract. For the impacted window 09:08-09:18 (10m), rough SLA breach calculation: given 42k failures vs expected baseline, should be considered a partial outage.

jason-oncall-sre: logging timeline here for RCA:
- 09:07: minor error jitter begins
- 09:08: 5xx ramp starts
- 09:12: autoscaler adds nodes that crash immediately
- 09:13: peak errors
- 09:15: isolation + routing to fallback implemented
- 09:18: error rate near baseline

priya-platform: followups: 1) rollback variant on nebula-pool-2, 2) add sequence-length guardrails to autoscale config for nebula-prod, 3) add better per-tenant mem headroom metric to detect pre-failure.

jess-cust-succ: drafting customer email. here's the first pass — please comment: 

```
Hi Claire / Nebula team,

We're writing to follow up on the incident this morning that affected your nebula-prod environment. Short summary: between 09:08 and 09:18 UTC we observed elevated 5xx errors for requests served from your dedicated pool (nebula-pool-2). Our immediate mitigation was to isolate the pool and route traffic to a stable fallback pool, which restored service by 09:18 UTC.

What happened: a recent model variant rollout combined with an unusually high proportion of long sequences in your workload caused memory instability on some GPU nodes, which triggered crashes and request failures.

Impact: approximately 42k requests failed (rough estimate) during the 10-minute window; approximately 12% of requests returned truncated responses. We understand this impacted customer-facing requests in your UI.

What we did: isolated the pool, failed traffic to fallback, rolled back the variant on the affected pool, and are implementing additional guardrails (sequence-length limits, improved headroom metrics).

Planned next steps: full RCA with timeline and logs by EOD tomorrow; recommended configuration changes to avoid recurrence; and proposal for service credit.

Proposed credit: we propose a 7% service credit for the billing cycle for nebula-prod in recognition of the availability impact.

We sincerely apologize for the disruption. If you'd like, we can schedule an executive briefing in the next 48 hours.

Regards,
Jess (Customer Success) on behalf of Redwood Inference
```

olivia-product: suggested wording: call out exact affected endpoints, add a short technical appendix, and offer a live runbook review with Nebula.

ella-am: credit math check — 7% looks reasonable but we should validate contract language. Jess, mark as "proposed" and I'll loop Legal.

jason-oncall-sre: internal follow-ups: open follow ticket ENG-RT-5832 for rollback verification, ENG-PLAT-5833 for autoscale guardrails, SRE-OBS-5834 for per-tenant headroom metric. Assigning to Samir / Priya / Mike.

samir-runtime: adding notes to RCA bucket. Also recommending delaying global rollout of q4_1-2 until we run sequence-length regression tests with Nebula corp workload samples (need opt-in).

jess-cust-succ: Claire asked if we can expedite a credit and an exec note. I'll send the draft above now and mark the credit as "proposed 7%" pending legal sign-off.

priya-platform: rolling change to autoscale guardrails now — adding max-seq-length check and memory-margin 20%. Will monitor canary.

mike-eng-runtime: rollback to q4_1-stable completed on nebula-pool-2 at 10:02 UTC. No regressions seen in 30m canary. Ready to rejoin when AM confirms.

ella-am: prefer to wait until we have the RCA sketch before scheduling exec briefing; however if customer requests earlier we can do a short standup.

jess-cust-succ: Claire confirmed they'd like an exec briefing tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Scheduling invite and prepping one-slide summary + timeline. Will include: timeline, impact metrics, remediation, credits, next steps.

olivia-product: for the customer one-pager include: root cause (variant + seq distribution), immediate mitigations (isolation, rollback), long-term fixes (guardrails, pre-rollout regression), and proposed credit. Keep it 1 page.

samir-runtime: attaching locations (internal): traces -> s3://incidents/nebula/2816004321/traces, logs -> s3://incidents/nebula/2816004321/logs, RCA notes -> google doc (link pasted in thread).

jason-oncall-sre: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. We'll transition to post-incident channel for RCA drafting in ~2h. If anyone sees a regression ping here.

jess-cust-succ: final note — we'll push the customer draft after Legal confirms credit wording. Adding action item: AM + Legal to confirm credit by EOD so we can include in customer email. (added :eyes: reaction)

incident-bot: Incident 2816004321 status changed to MITIGATED by jason-oncall-sre at 2816004900
